meta.name: managing-media
meta.description: Implements media and file management components including file upload (drag-drop, multi-file, resumable), image galleries (lightbox, carousel, masonry), video players (custom controls, captions, adaptive streaming), audio players (waveform, playlists), document viewers (PDF, Office), and optimization strategies (compression, responsive images, lazy loading, CDN). Use when handling files, displaying media, or building rich content experiences.

copy.tagline: 在网页中集成文件上传、媒体播放与图片展示功能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在网页中处理文件上传、图片画廊或音视频播放。
